No sign-up; answers stay in your browser.
hub.lede: Eighty-five free tests, from 16 personality types, the Big Five and the 12 archetypes to your parenting style, your color season and which flower or mythical creature you are, Harry Potter, Star Wars and Dragon Ball fan quizzes, and quick self-checks for stress, insomnia, OCD and adult ADHD. No sign-up, no email. Your answers are scored in your browser and never uploaded.
about: Each test lists all of its questions on one page. Answer them, press the button, and the result appears under the questions with a short explanation and a chart of your scores.

Four wellbeing checks use published screening questionnaires (WHO-5, Rosenberg, GAD-7, PHQ-9); the stress, social anxiety, OCD, insomnia, burnout and adult ADHD checks were written for cv.cm and have not been clinically validated. The Big Five and the introvert–extrovert test use the public-domain IPIP item pool. The other tests, including codependency, imposter syndrome, grit, communication style, parenting style and the 12 archetypes, are written for cv.cm from well-known models, and their results are a starting point for reflection, not a verdict. The game, anime, book, film and TV quizzes are unofficial fan quizzes, just for fun.

faq.a: Yes. Every test is free, with no sign-up, no email, and no paywall in front of the result.
No. Scoring runs in your browser tab. The answers are not uploaded or stored, and closing the tab clears them.

faq.q: How accurate are online personality tests?
faq.a: A short self-report test describes how you see yourself today. Treat the result as a mirror for reflection, and retake it after a while: results that stay the same are the ones to trust.

faq.q: Which test should I start with?
faq.a: For a quick type, take the 16 personalities test. For the model psychologists use most, take the Big Five. For relationships, try the love language or attachment style test.
